title: GLUE
body:
The Atari ST's [[System Controller]] chip. It sits between the [[Motorola 68000]] and
everything else on the [[System Bus]], doing address decoding (which chip owns this
address, see [[Decoder]]), bus arbitration, and generating the video and
[[VBL ISR|vertical blank]] timing signals.

"Glue logic" is the general term for the miscellaneous circuitry holding a system's chips
together; here it is an actual chip with that name.
